When the category a2 is not 1, it first writes a constant 12 and the category to the sub-object at obj+0x14/+0x18 and performs a virtual dispatch through the sub-object vtable before allocating. Returns the new node pointer.

Write the category a2 to the sub-object field obj+0x18 (reached as *a1 + 24).
Read the this vtable pointer at this+0x0 to reach the sub-object, then virtual-dispatch through the sub-object vtable at obj+0x0, calling (*(*a1))(a1) with the object itself as the argument.
Call MemoryAllocator(a1, a2, 0x78) to obtain a 120-byte node block.
Store a5 at node+4, a4 at node+8, and a6 at node+12.
Zero the byte at node+34 and store the type byte a3 at node+32.
Link new node: node+36 receives the current head from (v6 + 64), then (v6 + 64) is set to the new node. Packet facts anchor this list at this+0x44.
Return the new node pointer as the result.
